ethnicity.notes: Consumer Credit Directive (EU 2023/2225) requires creditworthiness assessment based on relevant information; protected attributes may not be used.

gender.notes: Gender may not be used as an actuarial / pricing factor since 21 Dec 2012.

genetic.legal_basis: GDPR Art. 9; Member State law often restricts use in financial services

age.legal_basis: Directive 2000/78/EC; case law on financial-services age limits

postcode.notes: Strong proxy for ethnicity / social origin; EU AI Act high-risk credit-scoring (Annex III §5(b)) requires proxy detection.
